name: FUSS: Free Universal Sound Separation Dataset
description: FUSS (Free Universal Sound Separation) is an open audio benchmark designed for training and evaluating universal sound separation systems on arbitrary acoustic mixtures. Sourced from FSD50K pre-release audio and convolved with simulated room impulse responses, it provides 12,377 source clips used to synthesize reverberant mixtures of varying polyphony.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (Zenodo Archive) / CC0 (Source Audio)
license.notes: The dataset archive deposit on Zenodo is released under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY-4.0). The underlying single-source audio recordings were drawn from Freesound and are dedicated to the public domain under Creative Commons Zero 1.0 (CC0). Audio event labels follow the FSD50K taxonomy under CC-BY-4.0, while reverberant mixture simulation code is released under Apache License 2.0.

verification.notes: Verified against ICASSP 2021 publication (DOI: 10.1109/ICASSP39728.2021.9414774) and official Zenodo archive (records 3710392 / 3743844). 12,377 source audio clips partitioned across 7,237 train, 2,883 validation, and 2,257 evaluation clips (approx. 23 hours of single-source audio across 357 sound classes), used to synthesize 20,000 train, 1,000 val, and 1,000 eval reverberant mixtures.

size.notes: 16-bit 16 kHz WAV audio files and room impulse response metadata.
